description: Oracle-only mechanism analysis for LRML and explicit-affinity label propagation. 'normal' leaves the graph unchanged while recording hidden-label edge purity; 'random_pruned' removes a seeded random set with exactly the oracle's edge count; 'oracle_pruned' removes only cross-class edges. No condition adds or reweights edges. These variants leak hidden training labels and must never be reported as valid SSL results or used for HPO/model selection.
name: graph_edge_pruning
